# CUDA runtime license provenance / CUDA 运行库许可证来源

`NVIDIA-CUDA-12.8-LICENSE.txt` is copied verbatim from NVIDIA's CUDA 12.8.0 redistributable manifest's cudart 12.8.57 archives. Windows and Linux archive LICENSE files have identical bytes. Minimal toolkit installers do not necessarily install a root-level EULA, so packaging uses this reviewed, checksum-pinned copy rather than silently omitting the license.
此文件逐字节来自 NVIDIA 官方 CUDA 运行库归档；精简安装器可能不安装顶层 EULA，故打包固定副本而非跳过许可文件。

- Manifest: https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/redist/redistrib_12.8.0.json
- Windows archive: https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/redist/cuda_cudart/windows-x86_64/cuda_cudart-windows-x86_64-12.8.57-archive.zip
  - SHA-256: `2c7aa62a195d79229d4381c8bd0174a30502cf3d8124c6e94ee50a7fc8a1e9f4`
- Linux archive: https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/redist/cuda_cudart/linux-x86_64/cuda_cudart-linux-x86_64-12.8.57-archive.tar.xz
  - SHA-256: `5bd3ac35ea8e8ab880e595d5054ee373abf6d9e53dcb8cef0a5c75358dbc0ae2`
- Extracted LICENSE SHA-256: `e2c71babfd18a8e69542dd7e9ca018f9caa438094001a58e6bc4d8c999bf0d07`

Retrieved and cross-checked on 2026-09-11. This notice records provenance, not a change to NVIDIA's terms or a relicensing of its runtime. Changing CUDA series requires reviewing the corresponding license and package configuration.
